name: The Thousand Scales
pitch: Your bare fist keeps four wounds open for free, every cap they hit widens the cap, and if they kill you in the first second they still lose two-thirds of their health walking away.

new.name: Widening Wound
new.effect: Half of what dot_pulse_cap clips at a pulse adds to that cap on this target for the rest of the fight, never past distinct statuses x dot_pool_cap.

new.name: Parting Cut
new.effect: When you go Down, your statuses run out before the result is final; you do nothing and the winner may cleanse.
new.second_home: any poison NPC, any assassin hired to die

new.name: Unspent Rage
new.effect: After a fight in which dot_pulse_cap clipped, +1 heart demon.
new.second_home: anything else a cap clips and a life could pay for

new.name: Kept Grudge
new.effect: +1 point on over-time tags per point of heart demon.

new.name: Thin Bleed
new.effect: On hit, apply a wound named for the piece that carries it: c_tick 0.2, 4 pulses, stacks to 5. Wounds from different pieces are different statuses. Held four times here: Bleed, Brine, Gall and Sinew.
new.second_home: any blade, Water, poison or thể tu build

new.name: Scale-Knife Method
new.effect: Main, Huyền giai, Metal and Water. Scaling Stroke in three forms and Rub Salt, seals Open Seams, stops at Core Formation.

new.name: Scaling Stroke
new.effect: One art in three forms, each slotted on its own: body and metal, qi and metal, qi and water. c_art 0.5, cost 0.02, 1 s. Each form applies its own wound (Scale, Seam, Gill), c_tick 0.15, 4 pulses.

new.name: Rub Salt
new.effect: Curse, cost 0.03, 3 s: shred 0.3 for 3 pulses.

new.name: Gutter's Knife
new.effect: cham base with the Thin Bleed affix, which a generated knife could roll.

new.name: Open Seams
new.effect: Theme statuses, Water, outer, sealed by a technique, size 10. Notables Thin Bleed (Gall) and Kept Grudge, capability Widening Wound.

new.name: Destruction, Wrath branch
new.effect: Thin Bleed (Sinew), Spillover, Unspent Rage, ending in Parting Cut.

questions: The status lint reads c_tick x duration against an equal-cost art. A status from a trigger has no such art. Should it have a lint of its own?
Should a Down cultivator's wounds outlive them, or is that one rule too many for rule 14?
Unspent Rage breaks 'kills add no heart demon' on purpose, for one build. Is that exception acceptable?
